messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long int i,n,top,t,k,arr[500000],m=INT_MAX,bs;

void f(long long int x,long long int s,long long int k,long long int kk){
  if(s>=i)
      return ;
  if(x==0){
        printf("%d",s);   
        exit(0);
    }
    while(k>x){ k/=10; kk--;}
    f(0,s+((k*10+1)-x)+kk+1,k*10+1,kk+1);
    long long int t=x/k;
    f((k*10+1)-x,s+kk+1,k,kk);
    f(x-(k*t),s+(kk*t),k,kk);
    
}

int main(){
    scanf("%lld",&n);
    k=1;
    bs=1;
    while(k*10+1<=n){
        k=k*10+1;
        bs++;
    }
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
        f(n,0,k,bs);
    if(m==INT_MAX) m=min(n,11-n+2);
        printf("%lld",m);
    
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

long long int i, n, top, t, k, arr[500000], m = numeric_limits<long long int>::max(), bs;

void f(long long int x, long long int s, long long int k, long long int kk) {
  if (s >= i) return;
  if (x == 0) {
    cout << s;
    exit(0);
  }
  while (k > x) { k /= 10; kk--; }
  f(0, s + ((k * 10 + 1) - x) + kk + 1, k * 10 + 1, kk + 1);
  long long int t = x / k;
  f((k * 10 + 1) - x, s + kk + 1, k, kk);
  f(x - (k * t), s + (kk * t), k, kk);
}

int main() {
  cin >> n;
  k = 1;
  bs = 1;
  while (k * 10 + 1 <= n) {
    k = k * 10 + 1;
    bs++;
  }
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++) f(n, 0, k, bs);
  if (m == numeric_limits<long long int>::max()) m = min(n, 11 - n + 2);
  cout << m;
}

</variant_1>
